title: Cock Back
label: Aftershock

type.basis: Evidence specimen; produced by Terror Danjah, with documented later versions.

sound.text: Terror Danjah's producer tag, a distorted 'gremlin' laugh from a drum and bass sample CD, is part of his sound (artist-level, not confirmed on this track).

context.text: It was the 'Power Play' on Deja Vu FM and topped the sales chart at Rhythm Division; Terror Danjah claimed sales of about 10,000.
Nasty Crew was founded in 1999 by Plaistow-based artists, with members mainly from Newham; Terror Danjah, from Forest Gate (per his own Wikipedia page), was invited in.
Aftershock was co-founded in 2002 by Terror Danjah and Flash, initially as a vinyl-only label, with printed colour labels from its second release.

rels.other: Cock Back (East Co. Version), 2004, on 'Box Bloody Fresh', featuring Jookie Mundo and Demon
Cock Back V1.2, featuring Riko Dan and Bruza, on 'Run the Road' (679 Recordings, 24 January 2005)

uncertainty: The artist credit varies: the Nasty Crew article gives Hitman Hyper and D Double E with guests Crazy Titch and Riko Dan, while the Aftershock article says 'Nasty Crew feat. Titch and Riko Dan'. The Run the Road article credits 'Terror Danjah featuring Riko, Bruza, D Double E and Hyper' (the V1.2 version). No catalogue number was found.
tracklist: Vocal record over a Terror Danjah beat; later versions are listed under relationships.
